description: This PHP source file defines a controller class 'Gdpr' within the Opencart administrative module, handling GDPR-related user management functions such as listing, approving, denying, and deleting GDPR requests. It manages request handling, permission checks, and interactions with related models to process GDPR data.

classes.name: Gdpr
classes.description: Controller class managing GDPR requests in the OpenCart admin interface. Handles listing, approval, denial, and deletion of GDPR user data requests.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the GDPR management page with breadcrumbs, headers, and list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the GDPR request list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares GDPR request data, including filters, pagination, and links, for display.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Handles GDPR request approval, updating status accordingly after permission checks.

methods.name: deny
methods.description: Processes GDPR request denial, changing status after permission validation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes GDPR requests from the database after verifying permissions.
